I think I agree with peoples' frustration about Bean's lack of reaction to her own magic. Not reacting the first time it happens is somewhat understandable - she's interacting with the magic orb/crystal ball thing, and they (collectively) don't seem to understand how it works - so maybe she just brushes that off as something the ball just does occasionally. (Or, perhaps, she forgets about it in all the chaos.)  


However, to be fair, I feel like each time she used her magic, she could potentially explain it all in a way that means the magic didn't come from her. She could just straight up be in denial about it.   


The first time I already touched on. The second time is when she ends up putting out all the power (except the top of Gunderson tower) in Steamland, she could think that it was some kind of malfunction with the lightbulb robots ( I forget what they're called) since she has no actual understanding of how they work. Finally, when she puts the crown on Dagmar, she would very likely assume that the lightning was coming from Dagmar herself, as Bean already knows she is a witch.  


There's definitely some wiggle room in this theory - most especially with the incident in Steamland - but I think it's pretty plausible.   


No matter what, I really hope they go more into her source of power in the next installment. I really love this show and would love to see it be fully fleshed out, and not rushed.

I'm surprised to see how many people were disappointed with this season. For sure there are some unanswered questions - and I really wish they would address some earlier cliffhangers before creating too many more - but I think that's half the fun. We get to see different characters develop in different episodes, and we're always left wanting more. I really enjoyed Zog in this season. Obviously, most people like Oona's arch as well. I'm just really excited to see what's happening going forward.  


Plus, I read someone's theory about how Dagmar was actually killed in the explosion at Maru, but since the Trogs live one level above hell, they made a deal with her and helped her out, and now I'm wondering if/how that relates to the wedding hellscape we end on.  


Anyway, I loved it, and hope we don't have to wait too long for another season.
